WITH id_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        COUNT(*) as record_count,
        COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination) as share
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
),
avg_stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM id_counts
)
SELECT 
    AVG(ic.record_count) as avg_record_count,
    AVG(ic.share) as avg_share,
    AVG(ic.share - avg.avg_share) as avg_share_beat
FROM id_counts ic
CROSS JOIN avg_stats avg
WHERE ic.share > avg.avg_share    -- (6.25, 0.7754342431761788, 0.6445441908201589)
